curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with driving as a privilege you can lose, then how a moving-violation conviction notifies the Department and adds points, why too many points cost the privilege, and the two ways the guide states speeding points.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards separating the two-or-three point speeding example from the three points in the state law list.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a conviction and asking how points are added or how many speeding brings.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk up the point list from the two four-point violations through the five-point school bus violation to the four violations worth twelve points.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per violation value; contrast cards for the equal four-point pair and the group of twelve-point violations.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a violation and asking how many points it is worth.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Climb the thresholds from the four-point advisory to the eight-point suspension and its three lengths, then the three revocation windows and the six-point, twelve-month pattern that links them.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per threshold; contrast cards for advisory versus suspension and the three revocation windows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz giving a point total and a time window and asking what the Department does.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Split reinstatement into the alcohol-related and non-alcohol paths, then show the total dropping to four at reinstatement and the yearly cuts of one-third, one-half and then zero, with convictions that stay on the record.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per step; contrast cards for the two reinstatement paths and the order of the yearly fractions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver after a point suspension and asking what reinstatement needs or what the total becomes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Contrast driving during a suspension with driving during a revocation, then trace a missed court date from the thirty-day notice to the immediate suspension and what ends it.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per consequence; contrast cards for suspended versus revoked and paying the ticket versus paying the fee too.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver who kept driving or missed court and asking what follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the five points for a school bus conviction, the court-ordered suspension for a first offense, the longer suspensions for repeat offenses within five years, and how these lengths differ from point suspensions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per offense step; contrast cards for school bus versus point suspension lengths and the five-year window.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a school bus offense and asking how long the suspension runs.
